svg.title: Scherkenoid fundamental half-strip
svg.desc: Exact domain and boundary data at alpha equals pi over two, in the upward convention. The domain is x greater than zero and y between zero and w, with w at least pi. Height tends to positive infinity on the two horizontal rays and negative infinity on the vertical segment. Half-turns about the vertical lines through the two corners extend the fundamental graph.

g.text: Exact boundary data · α = π/2 · upward convention
w ≥ π; unbounded to the right
Each corner lifts to a whole vertical reflection line.
Two successive half-turns give the horizontal period (0, 2w, 0).
